text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be respectively necessary, are hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not appropriated for other purposes, in compensation of
the service of the Philippine Government for the fiscal year ending December thirty-first, nineteen hundred
and twenty-seven, unless otherwise stated:
[ PLS. See Original Image ]

Two reimbursable accounts are hereby created which shall be known as "Benguet Automobile
Line" and "Dwellings and Equipment for Rent in Baguio," for the operation, maintenance, and improvement
of the Benguet automobile line and of the dwellings and equipment of the Government for rent in Baguio,
respectively. Upon the approval hereof, all the assets and liabilities of the services above named shall be
transferred to said accounts, and a sum equivalent to the balance appearing when such transfer is made is
hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to constitute the
capital of each of said funds. The capital so provided for each of the two accounts above-mentioned, together
with their future accretions from the operating income of said services and future appropriations for the same,
shall be disbursed by the Director of Public Works, with the approval of a committee composed of the
Secretary of Commerce and Communications, the Secretary of Finance, and the Insular Auditor, for the
operation and maintenance, of said "Benguet Automobile Line" and "Dwellings and Equipment for Rent in
Baguio" and for the purchase and construction of the necessary equipment and buildings for said services.
As soon as possible after the close of each year, the Director of Public Works shall render a detailed financial
report of the operation during said year of the two accounts hereinbefore mentioned, to the Philippine
Legislature, through the Committee, and any surplus funds which in the opinion of the Committee are not
necessary for the operation of said services shall revert to the general funds in the Insular Treasury.

Any provision of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, no person shall be employed
under contract by the Insular Government unless this be authorized by an appropriation in this Act.

Any appropriation made in this Act for a position or employment shall be available exclusively
for the specific position for which it has been made and shall not be used for any other position, although the
latter be of the same nature as the former.

This Act shall take effect on January first, nineteen hundred and twenty-seven.
Approved, December 7, 1926.
